stubs.name: serve
stubs.doc: serve runs one connection: it sets c.conn, reads CRLF or bare-LF lines, dispatches through handlers, and calls Disconnect when the connection ends.

stubs.name: Send
stubs.doc: Send queues one protocol line for c. line carries no trailing CRLF and is already complete, including any leading ':'; Send only appends CRLF.

stubs.name: Reply
stubs.doc: Reply sends c a line from the server itself, built in full: ":" + serverName + " " + code + " " + target + " :" + text, where target is c.Nick, or "*" before c has a nick.

stubs.name: Prefix
stubs.doc: Prefix returns c's prefix, nick!user@freeq-lite, WITHOUT the leading ':'. Every sender of a prefixed line adds the ':' itself (":" + c.Prefix() + " JOIN ..."), including QUIT.

stubs.name: Disconnect
stubs.doc: Disconnect removes c from the server and from every channel, tells the channel peers ":" + c.Prefix() + " QUIT :" + reason (once each), then closes c.conn.
